gold: SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 60
